answer: Treat identity like a dune that only holds its shape while it stays in one place: standing accrues superlinearly with continuous, verified contribution history, and splitting that history across clones divides it like a crystal shattered — the shards are worth less than the whole. Clones each start at the bottom of the curve, so cloning buys many weak voices instead of one strong one. Earned standing sits in a vault keyed to the unbroken history itself; it cannot be copied, merged, or transferred, so the rational move is to keep one honest identity and tend it.
